Provider discovery in the base artifact has no available cloud OCR product path: paid brokered mpdf-credits is unavailable and Gemini BYOK is disabled. The explicit-endpoint generic API compatibility surface is separate.
The base artifact intentionally omits and does not require an OCR runtime. Native-text PDFs work; scanned pages that require OCR report provider unavailable without the optional plugin.
Tesseract, the sidecar, and tessdata_best belong to an independently staged and verified optional-local-ocr-plugin artifact; its pending gate does not block the base profile.
Cloud bookmark generation does not exist.

The historical macOS arm64 record in docs/evidence/rc3-local-install-arm64.json predates the profile split and contains the old OCR overlay. A fresh docs/evidence/rc3-base-install-arm64.json record with distribution_profile=base and without bundled_ocr is required; Gatekeeper rejection remains expected for an ad-hoc build.
